name: Marine Iguana

review.observation: Full original: blunt salt-crusted grey snout, dark scaly trunk, dorsal crest and long curved claws. Tail ends in an artificial oval paddle-like blade, unlike a naturally flattened continuously tapering iguana tail; HOLD for anatomical tail repair. Only three feet are independently evident; far forelimb remains unresolved. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.

policyStatus: AUDIT_ONLY_CANDIDATE: production reviewed-presence.mjs still admits tail absence only.
